# Reshaping

Some entries are in a different layout than the target. Change their markup to fit the target and
keep the words:

- `* **Title**` with an indented paragraph becomes `### Title` with the paragraph unindented.
- A Bugfixes or Security bullet becomes one table row. Join its lines into one, and keep the wording.
  The Area or Severity cell is the only text you may add. Keep it to a few words, and take it from
  the entry.
